pairs.title: Normal speed (1x)
pairs.listen_for: Roughness, a faint buzz or flutter in vowels; which sounds like clean speech?
pairs.B: new playback (1x passes audio through untouched)

pairs.title: 1.5x speed
pairs.listen_for: Flutter, warble, doubled or swallowed syllables; which is easier to follow?

pairs.title: 2x speed
pairs.listen_for: Flutter, warble, doubled or swallowed syllables; which is easier to follow?

pairs.listen_for: Flutter, warble, doubled or swallowed syllables; which is easier to follow?

pairs.title: 3x speed, two settings of the new stretcher
pairs.listen_for: Smoothness versus clarity: one is smoother, the other drops fewer short sounds. Which would you use?

pairs.title: Local voice weights: q8 vs full precision
pairs.listen_for: Hiss in the pauses, grit or buzz on vowels, clarity.

pairs.title: Fresh vs cached audio (old cache quality)
pairs.listen_for: Replays and second readings come from the cache. Swishy or muffled consonants, a phasey sound?
pairs.B: cached at the old Opus setting (~36 kbps)

pairs.title: Fresh vs cached audio (new cache quality)
pairs.listen_for: Same question at the new cache setting.
pairs.A: cached at the new Opus setting (~57 kbps)

pairs.title: Pause, resume, skip and stop
pairs.listen_for: Clicks or thumps where playback pauses, resumes, jumps and stops.
